name: Corsair Mk I
description: A nimble single-seat fighter favored by rookie pirates.
quirks: Nimble — evasion +5% when hull < 50%

name: Viper Mk II
description: An upgraded fighter with reinforced plating and twin turrets.
quirks: Twin Linked — firing both small hardpoints costs 80% ammo

name: Phantom Blade
description: A rare stealth-plated fighter used by elite pirates.
quirks: Ghost Plating — 15% chance to dodge any hit
Stealth Systems — reduced detection range by enemies

name: Raptor Corvette
description: A medium warship bridging the gap between fighters and freighters. Fast for its size with twin cannons.
lore: The backbone of mid-tier pirate fleets.
quirks: Twin Cannons — fires two shots per volley

name: Viper Corvette
description: Upgraded corvette with enhanced shields and a medium weapon slot.
lore: Favored by veteran pirates who want firepower without sacrificing mobility.
quirks: Viper Strike — 15% chance to fire a second burst on crit

name: Bulkhead Hauler
description: A slow, sturdy cargo ship that can take a beating.
quirks: Reinforced Bulkheads — hull damage reduced by 10%

name: Shadow Runner
description: A legendary smuggler vessel with hidden compartments.
quirks: Hidden Holds — contraband scan chance halved
Overclocked Engines — can burst to 200 speed for 8 seconds

name: Ironwing Carrier
description: A heavy assault carrier bristling with turrets. Deploys drone swarms and fighter escorts. Very hard to kill.
quirks: Drone Overload — deploys 3 combat drones on engage
Turret Battery — 4 independent point-defence turrets
Fighter Bay — launches 2 escort fighters when hull < 70%

name: Vanguard Command Carrier
description: Supercarrier — the most powerful vessel short of a dreadnought. Heals fleet, deploys drones, and carries a full fighter wing.
quirks: Fleet Healer — heals all fleet ships by 2 HP/sec while on FOLLOW order
Heavy Turret Battery — 6 heavy turrets with overlapping fire arcs
Full Fighter Wing — launches 3 escort fighters at combat start
Command Presence — +10% mission success chance for all fleet ships

name: The Void Reaper
description: An ancient alien dreadnought of unknown origin. Its hull whispers.
quirks: Void Resonance — 20% chance any incoming hit is absorbed and returned as damage
Ancient Core — crew morale never drops below 50 while aboard
Apex Predator — all enemy ships have -20% accuracy against this vessel
lore: Found drifting in the Graveyard Sector with no crew manifest. The Void Collective claims it predates their civilization.

name: Stinger Interceptor
description: Blazing-fast glass cannon built purely for hit-and-run. Outmaneuvers everything but folds under sustained fire.
lore: Used by scouts who need to be gone before the enemy can blink.
quirks: Afterburner — speed burst +60 for 4 s once per fight

name: Ironjaw Gunship
description: A flying weapons platform. Slow and not much to look at, but every inch is bristling with guns.
lore: Pirates who want to win by simply having more firepower.
quirks: Heavy Ordinance — large hardpoint damage +20%

name: Wraith Scout
description: Ultra-light recon vessel. Tiny signature, huge sensor suite. Reveals enemy positions before they see you.
quirks: Sensor Suite — extends minimap radar by 300 px
Ghost Mode — 20% chance enemies lose target lock

name: Hammerfall Destroyer
description: Purpose-built warship. Thick armour, heavy forward guns, and a ram prow that doubles as a weapon.
lore: When subtlety fails, send a Destroyer.
quirks: Ram Prow — 15% bonus damage when closing distance at high speed
Damage Control — hull repair rate +2 HP/s in combat

name: Shadowfang
description: A cloaking corvette that strikes from shadows. Low visible profile; enemies get -30% accuracy against it.
lore: Nobody sees it until the hull is already breached.
quirks: Cloak Drive — 8 s stealth burst, 45 s cooldown
Precision Targeting — first shot from stealth always crits

name: Orebreaker Barge
description: Industrial mining vessel. Poor in a fight, but strip-mines asteroids in seconds and hauls enormous cargo.
lore: The richest pirates aren't always the best fighters.
quirks: Deep Drill — asteroid loot doubled
Cargo King — carries 3x normal cargo capacity

name: Ironclad Transport
description: Armoured troop carrier with massive boarding capacity. Weak guns but takes a punch and delivers a crew.
lore: The real weapon is the marines packed inside.
quirks: Boarding Specialist — boarding crew size +4
Marine Garrison — crew combat stat +2 while on this ship

name: Warbringer
description: A capital-class warship. The heaviest vessel you can fly solo. Massive guns, thick armour, slow as space itself.
lore: When a Warbringer shows up, everyone else leaves.
quirks: Capital Guns — large hardpoint shots pierce shields
Thick Hide — hull damage reduced 15%
Command Bridge — fleet ships get +5% combat stats

name: Marauder Carrier
description: A converted capital carrier bristling with turrets, drone bays, and a full fighter bay. Slow and unmistakable, but when its bay doors open the battle changes.
lore: They called it a city with guns. The crew called it home.
quirks: Bay Doors — launches 1 docked ship each time hull drops 25%
Turret Battery — 6 independent turrets fire simultaneously
Drone Overload — 4 combat drones deployed every 12 s
Capital Armour — hull damage reduced 12%
Command Aura — all launched ships get +10% damage and speed
